reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, because a named independent lab and a per-batch report is what I look for. I would try one box of the bisglycinate for sleep and keep a few sachets in my gym bag, but I would check the report before I order a second.
objection: Zero reviews and it is not NSF or USP certified, so I am trusting a brand nobody has vouched for yet. At $1 a serving it is also pricey for a no-name.
would_change_my_mind: NSF or USP certification, or a handful of verified reviews that confirm the lab report matches what is in the sachet.
